paragraphs: My name is Joshua/Shua, and I'm a 15-year-old sophomore and up-and-coming sports photographer currently shooting for my high school, CCDS.

I'm passionate about photography and capturing the energy, emotions, and biggest moments in sports. I enjoy being able to tell a story through my photos and give people a different perspective on the games and athletes I photograph.

As I continue developing my photography skills, I'm also very interested in pursuing a future career in sports marketing, sports media, and videography. My long-term goal is to work with larger organizations, major corporations, and professional sports teams.

When I'm not photographing games, I'm usually listening to music, lifting, playing video games, talking or hanging out with friends, or exploring a new hobby or passion. I also enjoy learning new things and spending time in my long-running Minecraft world.
SHUAFX is where I showcase my photography, share my work, and continue building my experience in the sports media industry.
